primary_rule: Maximize minimum expected placement payout across the 17 frozen retained fields; exact sample ties choose lexicographically. This labels a catalog leader, not an automatic application recommendation.
sensitivity_rules: Same rule on the 9 strict fields
Minimize maximum regret to the best frozen candidate in each field
scope: Frozen finite candidate pool, new opponent draws, unchanged hypothetical fitted populations. Model compatibility is not population identification. Old banks are known stress evidence. No averaging across fields implies a probability distribution over them.
